description: Four editable plugin source copies built with the desktop repository. Origin commits identify import baselines; sourceSha256 identifies the imported and locally adjusted source bytes.

plugins.name: @zaimokuza/dsh-acp-adapter

changes: Use the source assets/registry snapshot without a network refresh.
Remove ordinary documentation and README-only checks.
Use stable relative CSS module IDs and hashes.
Require explicit DSH_UPSTREAM_CHECKOUT for host integration tests.
Use pnpm 11.23.0, matching the desktop build toolchain.
Declare pnpm 11 dependency build permissions for clean installs.
Allow only the 277 exact DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 package versions present in the lockfile through the pnpm minimum-release-age policy.
Omit three newly added contract specs that depend solely on intentionally excluded upstream README and CI/publish workflow files; retain runtime, permissions and integration coverage.
Import the upstream v0.2.0-rc.2.1 runtime and regression-test delta while retaining offline registry, source delivery, and host-integration adaptations.

Import official v0.2.0-rc.2.7 runtime and executable regression-test updates through the exact release commit while retaining DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 peers, offline registry, local host-checkout and source-delivery adjustments. Omit ordinary upstream docs/workflows and CI-only Windows scripts; retain runtime and unit coverage.
Bind E2E mock-process and source-probe paths to the exported test root and explicit DSH_UPSTREAM_CHECKOUT, removing cwd assumptions in integrated-host runs.

Make the native/mock E2E fixture paths independent of process cwd; verify zoom at 200% using computed root zoom and actual rendered-height ratio while retaining recovery focus, bounds and scroll assertions.
Resolve Windows ACP commands through PATH/PATHEXT and wrap CMD/BAT shims using pinned cross-spawn; preserve escaped arguments through the managed Windows Job runner and native process launch.

plugins.name: dsh-boot-ocbc

changes: Import formal src, scripts and assets, excluding private .local research.
Use portable unit tests against formal source and separate optional host integration tests.
Add locked test dependencies and explicit DSH_HARNESS_ROOT integration entry.

plugins.name: dsh-atlassian-kanban

changes: Import formal sources and portable host/client unit tests.
Preserve HTTP and HTTPS rejectUnauthorized:false behavior.
Add package entry validation and independent test configuration and dependency lock.
Require explicit environment variables for private live-test fixture files.
Remove the unused aggregate settings writer and resource-cache variables; test the production settings writer.
Use host attachment interfaces instead of any without changing download or TLS behavior.
Show connection success without the authenticated account name.
Prefix all tools with kanban_ and update tool guidance and ACP bridge tests.
Add resizable single-line Jira and Bitbucket tables with local column preferences and full-text tooltips.
Declare the MCP SDK used directly by integration tests.

Contribute fixed DSH Atlassian Kanban guidance through the scoped systemPrompt.section lifecycle; declare the host system-prompt peer and clarify temporary search versus revision-checked query persistence in tool descriptions and schemas.

Test the real plugin lifecycle and native profile save/readback/restart, stable query IDs and credentials, ACP MCP discovery, temporary searches, save conflicts/failures and existing ask/auto permission decisions. Original sibling plugin sources are not synchronized.

Build alpha.10 with locked DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 development packages while retaining exact 0.1.7-rc.2 peer compatibility; derive generator target from its pinned dependency. Verify the production Host lifecycle, HMR-backed settings persistence and package; Restore the updated ACP adapter in the desktop bundle and retain native ACP bridge integration coverage.

Pass the real visible tool schemas to the updated ACP bridge in all integration call sites; verify discovery, temporary searches, revision-checked saves and ask/auto decisions against the new adapter.

Preserve selected Atlassian mention labels in a canonical reference envelope while retaining complete model-facing locators; pair with the desktop user-text projector so submitted references render as @ labels without changing ACP prompt admission or session schemas.

Fix synchronous HTTP request-construction failures without a late timeout callback; preserve complete reference wires in capped queue previews and atomic chip editing, with browser regression coverage.

Align Kanban controls, table headings and card details with DSH theme typography; limit selected-tab weight to 500 and remove duplicate configuration and query-retry actions while retaining table resizing and reference behavior.

sourceDigestAlgorithm: scripts/build-plugins.mjs sourceDigest: sort all included POSIX relative file paths by codepoint, append UTF-8 byte length of path + colon + path + file byte length + colon + file bytes, SHA256 the concatenation. Excludes node_modules, lib, dist, .local, .git, .cache, .typert, .DS_Store and *.tsbuildinfo.
